_meta.name: Quaternion Decomposition (QD)
_meta.status_long: This folder is an experimental research project exploring whether the CNT (Compositional Navigation Tensor) operators can be expressed natively in quaternion algebra (with time as the scalar part). It is intentionally located OUTSIDE the Hs canonical repo at the Cowork-workspace root so it cannot accidentally be pushed. Status will change to 'CANDIDATE' if a corpus comparison validates one or more of the testable predictions, then 'PROPOSED INCLUSION' if the system benefits warrant integration into the HCI-CNT subsystem.
_meta.do_not_push_until: Status is changed by Peter explicitly. Until then, no file from this folder lands on origin/main.

central_claim.two_sentence: CNT measures invariance. CNQ names the algebra that invariance lives in.
central_claim.one_paragraph: The Higgins Decomposition system, in its CNT form, is an instrument for measuring invariance in compositional dynamics. CNT detects that compositional time-series carry three specific structural invariances: simplex rotation (SO(D-1)), mass-flow handedness preservation, and time-reversal symmetry. The CNQ tier names the algebra in which those three invariances are unified: quaternions for D=4, biquaternions for D=8, Clifford Cl(D-1) in general. CNT is the measurement; CNQ is the naming.
central_claim.origin: Identified by Peter on 2026-05-07 in the Round 2.5 conversation, after the boson-falsification result clarified what LIMIT_CYCLE_P2 universality actually means.

scope.investigates: Whether CNT's four channels (theta, omega, kappa, sigma) plus time fit naturally into a quaternion structure (1 scalar + 3 vector), and whether that structure exposes operations CNT currently emulates by hand.
scope.does_not_replace: Anything in HCI-CNT/ is the canonical engine. QD is a candidate alternative VIEW on the same scientific result, not a candidate replacement.
scope.deliverable_form: Documents only at this stage. No code execution against the canonical engine. No modifications to the determinism gate or the corpus.

files.README.json: this file — status flag for any AI session or user / researcher collaborator landing here
files.QD_PROJECT_ADMIN.json: project admin — current state, milestones, gate criteria, sequencing
files.QD_CONCEPTS_FOR_TEST.md: the catalogue of quaternion correspondences to investigate, each labelled by claim strength (ISOMORPHISM / EQUIVALENCE / ANALOGY / CONJECTURE)
files.QD_BENEFITS_POST_CODA.md: what QD enables for system analysis after CodaWork 2026 — the case for considering integration
files.QD_CORPUS_COMPARISON_PLAN.md: how to test QD against the existing 25-experiment CNT corpus — CNT runs are the standard to surpass and include
files.QD_DEEPER_CONNECTIONS.md: the deeper structural correspondences with rigour — more 'pop' than the conversational sketch, with the math chains spelled out where the connection is exact

isolation_protocol._principle: QD lives outside the Hs canonical repo and the Hs Cowork mirror, at the workspace root. This isolation prevents accidental contamination of CNT's locked schema, locked engine, locked doctrine, and locked determinism gate while QD is still exploratory.
what_QD_can_read: Anything in HCI-CNT/ (engine source, atlas modules, handbook volumes, experiments INDEX, corpus JSONs)
Anything in ai-refresh/ (CCTT, OPERATIONS_PROTOCOL, admin files)
what_QD_must_not_do: Push anything from this folder to origin/main
Suggest schema 2.x bumps, doctrine changes, or engine-source patches based on QD analysis until status promotion
Be referenced from any registered admin file (HS_ADMIN.json, HS_MACHINE_MANIFEST.json, OPERATIONS_PROTOCOL.md) until status promotion

status_promotion_path.0.0.1-experimental: Current. Documents only. No corpus comparison run yet.
status_promotion_path.0.1.0-candidate: If at least 2 testable predictions in QD_CONCEPTS_FOR_TEST.md pass when run against the existing CNT corpus. Promote when Peter confirms.
status_promotion_path.0.2.0-validated: If the corpus-comparison plan (full 25-experiment run with quaternion view) reproduces every CNT content_sha256 byte-for-byte AND adds at least one new diagnostic that CNT cannot compute in its current form.
status_promotion_path.0.3.0-proposed-inclusion: If 0.2.0 holds and the system-benefits document makes a clear case for HCI-CNT integration. At this stage QD becomes a draft Volume IV proposal, not a folder.
status_promotion_path.1.0.0-integrated: If Peter approves and the integration is implemented in HCI-CNT/ as a new view layer (engine + corpus + doctrine all unchanged; QD adds a quaternion-coordinate representation alongside the existing channel representation).

trigger: Peter's question after CCTT v1.0 + OPERATIONS_PROTOCOL v1.0 shipped: 'Quaternions, cnt but using direct 4d access time included in system structure not a bolt on. interesting does cnt plus time fit neatly in to a Quaternion?' followed by 'i saw Claude's what popped out and i want more pop is see the connection is real.'
principle: The instrument reads. The expert decides. The hashes carry the receipts. The protocol holds the line so the work can move forward. QD is exploration; CNT is canon; the line between them is enforced by folder isolation until evidence promotes the line.
